A.lost: The right to build the project as designed under the old code, and with it the project the developer financed on that assumption.

B.lost: The doses or mix thawed and not used, discarded at closing and replaced by the next order.

C.lost: A ruling on the merits and any remedy the forum could have given, gone because the harm ended before the forum sat.

D.lost: The clot-busting drug and the brain tissue it would have saved, withheld because nobody was awake to see the onset.

E.lost: Every signature or tender gathered so far and the recall or deal they would have made, all to be gathered again from zero.

F.lost: The matter's place in the process and the specific body that would have said yes, so the holder starts over before a body that owes it nothing.

G.lost: The paused position itself: the claim barred by limitations, the house foreclosed, the post gone, or the price the counterparty now charges to renew.

H.lost: The transplant the machine was buying time for, so the patient's life, or the mine's workings and the company's outside successor.

I.lost: Access to the holder's own money, and in the bail-in the money itself, taken in the hours the holder could not move it.

J.lost: The slot, the water right, or the mark, and the business that ran on it, returned to the pool for want of use.

K.lost: The debt owed or the right to sue, discharged on a date the holder never saw in a paper the holder never read.

L.lost: The permission to operate at all: the product's authorization, the cross-state licence, the premises under the sub-lease.

M.lost: The way back: the old state can no longer take over, so a failed change must be fixed forward at whatever cost that turns out to be.

N.lost: The objection, the patent, or the appeal, waived by an adjacent act the holder did not know was linked to it.

O.lost: Sight in the weak eye for the rest of the child's life, lost before anyone noticed there was an eye to save.

P.lost: The seat itself, the post, the budget line, the founder's chair, absorbed so that coming back means applying from outside.

Q.lost: The promised renewal, the job held open, the supplier's priority, gone with the person whose word held it and never given by the successor.

R.lost: The exit to the buyer who could have paid, so the company must find a larger acquirer or a listing it may never reach.
